description: Ministry of Finance - Order under Special Commodity Levy Act that a Special Commodity Levy of Rs. 5 per kg on Importation of Broken Rice. This order shall be valid for a period of 03 months commencing from 01.07.2017
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains a regulatory order with specific rates and implementation details, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
